startup_commands.label: judge-demo
startup_commands.notes: Installs dependencies, runs smoke checks, starts the local API and client, and opens the main demo routes.

smoke_commands.label: demo-smoke
smoke_commands.notes: Validates core fixture and contract integrity before UI-specific validation.

direct_evidence_requirements: Capture the exact UI state that demonstrates the claimed issue or fix.
Generic, background, or unrelated screenshots do not count as direct evidence.
ui_acceptance_checks: No overlap or collision in the mobile viewport.
No awkward wrapping in critical HUD or status UI.
Primary interaction keeps stronger hierarchy than any added status or helper UI.
The fix reduces cognitive load instead of adding clutter.

surfaces.notes: Vocabulary feed and clustering review surface.
YouTube overlay and subtitle augmentation surface.

debug_hooks.name: sessionLogger
debug_hooks.usage: Use window.sessionLogger.getCurrent(), getAll(), export(), and clear() during browser-backed runs.

debug_hooks.name: hangoutUseChat
debug_hooks.usage: Trace useChat, toolQueue, processingRef, and continue flow when investigating interaction/state bugs.

notes: Differentiate live-model output from fallback or static/dev responses before claiming a fix.
Do not claim success unless the evidence shows actual Korean dialogue plus the tapped pronunciation surface.
Expected behavior: a player may tap once to finish the typewriter effect and again to advance.
Bug behavior: the UI appears ready to advance, the tap lands, but no meaningful state transition happens.
Capture transition evidence, not a single still frame.
Regression target: the stale Block Crush board never becomes visible after completion.
Distinguish transport-level streaming from user-visible progressive rendering.
Capture timestamps for request start, first visible dialogue, incremental updates, and completion.

steps: Open the fresh onboarding flow and progress through Tong intro until the profile/language settings step is visible.
Capture the language selection UI before changing any controls.
Test whether a player can clearly tell what each control means and whether all three languages are forced.

direct_evidence: Capture the complete onboarding language-selection step before changing any controls.
Capture the specific controls, labels, or forced-default behavior that make the flow ambiguous.
ui_acceptance_checks: A new player can tell what each language control changes without prior explanation.
Any clarification reduces onboarding ambiguity without adding more visual clutter.
stop_conditions: If the fix depends on deciding whether language selection belongs on one screen versus multiple future onboarding screens, stop after validation and proposal.
If the fix implies syncing onboarding choices with future web-form or account-setting flows, stop and defer to a human product decision.

steps: Open the first hangout scene.
Capture the initial whisper and empty-space composition.
Verify the discoverability of Tong whisper and the continue affordance.
Open the Block Crush dev exercise.
Capture the lives indicator and active gameplay state.
Check whether the time or pressure state is visually understandable.

direct_evidence: Capture the narrow mobile gameplay state that shows how the pressure or timing HUD reads during play.
Capture the exact HUD or status treatment that competes with the game board if present.
ui_acceptance_checks: Critical gameplay HUD does not overlap or wrap awkwardly on narrow mobile.
Status UI clarifies pressure without competing with the board or making the screen busier.
stop_conditions: If the fix relies on subjective visual hierarchy or adding persistent HUD or status copy, stop after validation and proposal.
Do not claim success for a change that makes the screen busier even if the raw data is more explicit.

steps: Open a hangout and leave the HUD closed initially.
Capture whether the pull tab is obvious without prior instruction.
Open the HUD and capture the charge meter and XP/SP/RP labels.

direct_evidence: Capture the closed HUD state that shows whether the pull tab is discoverable without instruction.
Capture the open HUD state that shows the charge meter and XP, SP, and RP label hierarchy.
ui_acceptance_checks: Any discoverability fix improves hierarchy without adding competing HUD text.
Charge, XP, SP, and RP remain readable on mobile without visual clutter or awkward wrapping.
stop_conditions: If the change depends on subjective discoverability or hierarchy judgment, stop after validation and proposal.
Do not add persistent helper copy unless a human explicitly approves the tradeoff.

steps: Open the main game surfaces in a mobile viewport.
Capture text-heavy states including dialogue, whisper, and HUD.
Verify whether text and touch targets remain comfortably readable.

direct_evidence: Capture the specific crowded states that motivate the readability complaint, not only generic game frames.
ui_acceptance_checks: Any proposed readability change should improve hierarchy across dialogue, whisper, and HUD instead of creating new inconsistency.
stop_conditions: If the fix becomes broad cross-cutting typography cleanup, stop after validation and proposal so the scope can be sequenced deliberately.

steps: Open a hangout scene with Korean dialogue visible in the main immersive text.
Capture the main sentence and verify it uses native script with no inline parenthetical romanization.
Tap a Korean token and capture the tooltip or dictionary state that exposes pronunciation placement.
Record whether the run exercised live-model output, fallback content, or only a static or dev route.
screenshot_targets: actual Korean dialogue state in the main message bubble
tooltip or dictionary state for the tapped Korean token
pronunciation placement outside the main immersive sentence

direct_evidence: Capture an actual Korean dialogue sentence in the main immersive bubble.
Capture the tapped tooltip or dictionary card for the same Korean token.
Capture where pronunciation or romanization appears instead of inline parentheses.
ui_acceptance_checks: Native script remains primary in the main immersive sentence.
Inline parenthetical romanization does not appear in immersive dialogue.
Pronunciation is available in tooltip, dictionary, or audio UI without displacing the main sentence.
stop_conditions: If only fallback or canned or dev content was exercised, mark the run partial or blocked and do not claim the issue fixed.

steps: Open the first hangout scene in QA mode.
Progress until a continue affordance is visible and reproduce the wasted tap if possible.
Export session logs and state snapshots immediately after any tap that appears to do nothing.
Distinguish expected typewriter skip from a genuine no-op continue tap.

direct_evidence: Capture the visible continue-ready state immediately before the wasted tap.
Capture the post-tap no-op state plus the correlated QA logs or state export.
stop_conditions: If tracing still leaves multiple plausible state-race explanations, stop after evidence and proposal instead of making a speculative fix.

steps: Open the Act 2 intro and progress until a Block Crush exercise completes.
Use burst screenshots or screen recording during the review-overlay dismissal.
Confirm whether the stale game board appears between the review overlay and the parent fade.

direct_evidence: Capture the transition sequence itself, not only the states before and after dismissal.
stop_conditions: If the stale-frame source is still ambiguous after transition tracing, stop after validation evidence and proposal.

steps: Open the first hangout scene in QA mode.
Capture request start, loading pulse, first visible dialogue, and the completion of the visible text.
Confirm whether the on-screen dialogue is progressively rendered or arrives as a complete payload after a gap.

direct_evidence: Capture timestamps or ordered evidence for request start, first visible text, incremental updates, and completion.
stop_conditions: If the issue spans transport timing and client rendering without a clearly isolated regression, stop after validation evidence and proposal.
